intent: Make `git push` return in about a second instead of ~13s, by not paying Node's startup cost to re-check markdown/JSON/YAML files whose content, prettier version and prettier config are all unchanged since their last clean check.
scope: endurain/README.md and linux_configuration/.github/copilot-instructions.md - reflowed by prettier after the ~ reorganisation lengthened paths inside them
Non-goal: changing what prettier checks, its config, or the ci-mirror gate. The set of files that must be clean is identical before and after.
Non-goal: the first push after a requirements.txt change, which still rebuilds a clean venv by design.
changes: run_prettier_capped.sh now keys a result cache on sha256(file content) plus a fingerprint of `prettier --version` and every prettier config file, so a cached verdict cannot survive an edit, a prettier upgrade or a config change.
Files with a cached clean verdict are dropped from the argv; when the argv empties, prettier is never started at all.
Only a clean verdict is recorded - a failing check is re-run next time, so the cache can never mask a formatting regression.
The cache is wholesale-pruned past 20000 entries, which costs one slow run rather than correctness.
The systemd-run memory cap (MemoryMax=512M, MemorySwapMax=0) is preserved exactly, per the oom-prevention skill.

verification.command: bash meta/scripts/run_prettier_capped.sh <40 tracked markdown files>  # cold, then warm
verification.evidence: cold 0.652s with 40 cache entries written; warm 0.057s printing 'prettier: 40 file(s) unchanged since their last clean check'. 11x faster with no prettier process started.

verification.command: append trailing whitespace to README.md, re-run the same file list
verification.evidence: [warn] README.md - the edited file misses the cache and is re-checked; after `git checkout -- README.md` the run is clean again. Cache keyed on content, so an edit cannot be masked.

verification.command: git push --dry-run  (pre-push: prettier + ci-mirror + pre-commit pre-push stage)
verification.evidence: 13.0s before this change, 2.9s after, on the same 106-file push range. ci-mirror itself is 0.02s when its green-tree cache hits; the remainder was prettier's repeated Node startups.
no findings; shfmt applied, matching the repo's tab style.

risks: A cached verdict is trusted without re-running prettier. It is invalidated by file content, prettier version and prettier config, so the remaining exposure is a prettier behaviour change that ships without a version bump - which does not happen for a pinned release.
The cache lives under XDG_CACHE_HOME, outside the repo, so it is per-machine and a fresh clone or a cleared cache simply pays one full run.

prettier errors rather than warns on an explicitly-listed symbolic link (CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md). That behaviour is unchanged by this patch, but it means a push range containing CLAUDE.md fails the hook for a reason unrelated to formatting.
rollback: git revert the commit, or restore the previous run_prettier_capped.sh which called `prettier --check "$@"` unconditionally inside the same systemd-run scope.
After rollback, run `git push --dry-run` and confirm the prettier hook still passes; delete ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/prettier-gate, which is then unused.
